findings.title: A service, timer or autostart entry is installed
findings.message: writes into an autostart or unit directory (found in documentation: this is what users are told to run)
findings.remediation: Document every unit or autostart entry the tool installs and how to remove it. Prefer user units (systemctl --user) over system units.

findings.title: Commands run with elevated privileges
findings.message: sudo runs apt-get (embedded in GitHub Actions run step) (2 occurrences in this file: lines 21)
findings.evidence:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap
findings.remediation: Confirm every privileged command is necessary, scoped to a fixed command surface, and documented. Prefer user-level installation where possible.

findings.title: Kernel modules, initramfs or bootloader are modified
findings.message: kernel parameter changed at runtime (embedded in GitHub Actions run step)
findings.remediation: Hardware tools may legitimately need this; verify the module source and ship changes through a package with a pacman hook so they are reversible.

findings.title: QML plugin spawns processes or touches files
findings.remediation: Keep process invocations minimal, avoid shells (bash -c), and never run privileged commands from a UI plugin.
